# Easier, safer installation

PasteForward 0.2.0 adds native installation paths and a guided first run while
keeping service installation explicit.

## New

- Homebrew installation on macOS and Linuxbrew.
- Static Linux binaries plus Debian and RPM packages for x86_64 and arm64.
- Interactive `pasteforward init` setup when no arguments are supplied.
- `pasteforward test <dest>` verifies a real clipboard image end to end.

## Safety and reliability

- Setup validates and probes a destination before committing config.
- Doctor and init now return failure when required checks fail.
- SSH hosts and remote environment overrides are parsed fail closed.
- Commands, clipboard images, and captured output have fixed limits.
- User services retain a stable executable path across package upgrades.
- Release artifacts include checksums and build-provenance attestations.

No package installs clipboard dependencies or starts a background service.
